confidence_notes: Medium overall. Meal anchors draw on aggregated cost-of-living figures from search results (e.g., Numbeo, CityCost) that broadly agree but are partly user-submitted or dated (some 2023-2024), so they are not specific to July 2026. Coffee, beer, cocktail and wine rely on Taipei, national and limited Tainan data, adjusted for Tainan's lower price level; the wine glass figure is cross-checked against the local beer relationship because restaurant-specific wine data was sparse. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked. Local-currency figures were converted at roughly NT$31-33 per US$ without a separate TWD rate check. The FX value comes from search-result text citing the RBA exchange-rates page (not read directly); the latest date found is 2026-11-18.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tainan-specific aggregated figures for restaurant meals; Taipei and Taiwan-wide price points for coffee, beer, cocktail and wine, adjusted down for Tainan's lower price level; accommodation reflects a general Tainan budget-to-mid-range lodging tier.
